haiku45.summary_excerpt: Workflow YAML is well-structured (pinned actions, proper permissions, job dependencies), but PowerShell script lacks Set-StrictMode and input validation—best practices present but incomplete. Code is tight with no dead code. Clear naming and good comments throughout. However, deliverable is INCOMPLETE and non-functional: (1) Missing critical files: rules.json, fixtures/cases/*/changed-files.json, PrLabelAssigner.Tests.ps1, .actrc; test harness will fail immediately with 'no fixture cases found'.

gemini31pro.summary_excerpt: High-quality, modular, and well-tested solution. Excellent readability. Minor best practice deductions: missing Set-StrictMode in PowerShell, bash script omits -e instead of handling 'act' failure via ||, and GitHub action refs are not pinned by SHA.
